[SWS_Ea_00073] ⌈The function Ea_GetStatus shall return MEMIF_BUSY_INTER-
NAL, if an internal management operation is currently ongoing.⌋
Note: Internal management operation may e.g. be a re-organization of the used EEP-
ROM memory (garbage collection). This may imply that the underlying device driver is
- at least temporarily - busy.
